title: 💙 Kiran blows and blows, but her paper boat only spins in the puddle… #shorts #kidsstory #monsoon
title_alts: 💙 Why won't Kiran's paper boat sail across the puddle to the gate? #shorts #kidsstory #monsoon
💙 Beside the puddle Kiran's knees ache and her paper boat keeps tipping… #shorts #kidsstory #monsoon
refrain: Go, boat, go! One, two, three
description_hook: Kiran folds a paper boat and cannot make it sail. Then she notices something the puddle was doing all along.

characters.name: Kiran
characters.description: seven years old, short dark hair with a red clip, blue kurta rolled at the sleeves, bare feet

scenes.narration: Kiran wanted her paper boat to sail out the gate, right across the monsoon puddle. She set it down and chanted, "Go, boat, go! One, two, three."
scenes.caption: किरन चाहती थी कि उसकी कागज़ की नाव गेट तक पहुँचे। चलो नाव चलो! एक, दो, तीन।
scenes.image_brief: Kiran, a seven-year-old girl with short dark hair and a red hair clip, in a blue kurta with rolled sleeves, crouching barefoot beside a wide rain puddle on a village street, setting a small white paper boat on the water, bright light after rain

scenes.narration: She blew and blew at the folded sail. Blow with me, one big puff! The boat spun in a slow circle and tipped sideways.
scenes.caption: उसने मुड़े हुए पाल पर बार-बार फूँक मारी, नाव गोल घूमकर एक तरफ़ लुढ़क गई।
scenes.image_brief: Kiran leaning close to the puddle with her cheeks puffed out, blowing at the small paper boat, the boat tilted sideways on the water, ripples spreading outward, wet village street

scenes.narration: Water crept into the folds and the paper sail tore off in Kiran's fingers. Now there was nothing to blow at, and no dry paper at home.
scenes.caption: पानी अंदर भर गया और कागज़ का पाल उँगलियों में ही फट गया, घर में सूखा कागज़ भी नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: Close view of the small paper boat sitting flat in the puddle with its folded sail torn away, a wet scrap of paper between Kiran's fingers, her bare feet at the edge of the frame, overcast light

scenes.narration: Kiran dragged her heel through the mud, scratching a thin channel from the puddle to the gate. Dig a line with me! Water slid in and ran. "Go, boat, go! One, two, three," she sang.
scenes.caption: किरन ने एड़ी से मिट्टी में पतली नाली खोदी और पानी उसमें बहने लगा। चलो नाव चलो!
scenes.image_brief: Kiran dragging her bare heel through soft mud at the edge of the puddle, a thin scratched channel running from the puddle towards a metal gate, rainwater sliding along the new channel

scenes.narration: Then Kiran lifted the boat into the running water, and it slipped past her feet and out under the gate.
scenes.caption: किरन ने नाव बहते पानी में रखी और वह उसके पैरों से होकर गेट के नीचे निकल गई।
scenes.image_brief: Kiran standing barefoot in her blue kurta watching her paper boat travel along the narrow channel of rainwater beside a wall and out under a metal gate, warm late afternoon light on the wet road

scenes.narration: Go, boat, go! One, two, three.
scenes.caption: चलो नाव चलो! एक, दो, तीन।
scenes.image_brief: Kiran sitting on a low step with wet feet and muddy heels, smiling at the far gate, soft evening light, the road still shining with rain

title: 😃 Bela puts both lips together, so the letter B never comes out wrong… #shorts #phonics #learnwithme
title_alts: 😃 How does Bela know a tall line is not a B without two bumps? #shorts #phonics #learnwithme
😃 With Bela, the letter B needs two bumps, and buh needs closed lips… #shorts #phonics #learnwithme
description_hook: One letter, three everyday things, and a sound to say out loud together.

characters.name: Bela
characters.description: four years old, two short plaits, orange t-shirt, sitting cross-legged

scenes.narration: Today Bela is learning one letter. It is the letter B. B says buh, buh, B.
scenes.caption: आज बेला एक अक्षर सीख रही है, अक्षर B।
scenes.image_brief: Bela, a four-year-old girl with two short plaits in an orange t-shirt, sitting cross-legged on a bedroom floor with a large wooden letter B in her lap, warm lamp light

scenes.narration: Look at the shape. A tall line, and two round bumps beside it. Tall line, two bumps. That is B.
scenes.caption: एक लंबी लकीर और दो गोल उभार, यही है B।
scenes.image_brief: A large wooden letter B standing upright on a bedroom floor, Bela's finger tracing the tall line and the two round bumps, soft shadow behind it

scenes.narration: Here is a ball. Ball starts with buh. B says buh, buh, B.
scenes.caption: यह गेंद है, गेंद में buh की आवाज़ है।
scenes.image_brief: A blue and white rubber ball resting on a bedroom floor beside the wooden letter B, Bela's hand reaching towards it

scenes.narration: Now you try. Put your lips together and say it with Bela. Buh!
scenes.caption: अब तुम कहो, होंठ मिलाकर, buh!
scenes.image_brief: Bela with her lips pressed together mid-sound, looking straight ahead, the wooden letter B beside her, bright even light

scenes.narration: B says buh, buh, B.
scenes.caption: B कहता है buh, buh, B।
scenes.image_brief: Bela clapping once with the wooden letter B in front of her on the bedroom floor, cheerful lamp light

scenes.narration: A banana in the fruit bowl. Buh. A button on her shirt. Buh. Banana, button, ball.
scenes.caption: केला, बटन, गेंद - सब में buh।
scenes.image_brief: A yellow banana in a fruit bowl and a round shirt button laid side by side on a bedroom floor next to a blue ball, daylight from a window

scenes.narration: Which one starts with buh? A bell, or a cat? A bell! Bell starts with buh.
scenes.caption: कौन buh से शुरू होता है, घंटी या बिल्ली? घंटी!
scenes.image_brief: A small brass bell on the left and a sleeping grey cat on the right of a bedroom floor, the letter B standing between them

scenes.narration: Ball, banana, button, bell. All buh. B says buh, buh, B.
scenes.caption: गेंद, केला, बटन, घंटी - सब buh। B कहता है buh, buh, B।
scenes.image_brief: A ball, a banana, a button and a small bell arranged in a row on a bedroom floor with the wooden letter B behind them, soft evening lamp light

title: 🥺 Devi shakes the tree for the last guava, and only leaves come down… #shorts #kidsstory #sharing
title_alts: 🥺 Why does Devi stop stretching the moment Nanu runs up, crying? #shorts #kidsstory #sharing
🥺 For one week Devi has wanted that last guava… now Nanu wants the same #shorts #kidsstory #sharing
refrain: One guava, and two of us
description_hook: There is one guava left on the tree and two people who want it. Devi finds a third answer.

characters.name: Devi
characters.description: eight years old, long braided hair with a green ribbon, yellow frock, a small scar on her elbow

characters.name: Nanu
characters.description: her three-year-old brother, round cheeks, striped shorts, always barefoot

scenes.narration: Devi had wanted the last guava on the courtyard tree all week. Nanu wanted it too. "One guava, and two of us."
scenes.caption: देवी पूरे हफ़्ते उस आख़िरी अमरूद का इंतज़ार कर रही थी, और नानू भी।
scenes.image_brief: Devi, an eight-year-old girl in a yellow frock with long braided hair and a green ribbon, standing in a courtyard looking up at a single ripe guava high in the tree, morning light through the leaves

scenes.narration: On her toes, Devi shook the thin trunk hard. Shake it with me! Leaves came down. The guava did not.
scenes.caption: देवी ने पंजों पर खड़े होकर पतला तना ज़ोर से हिलाया। पत्ते गिरे, अमरूद नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: Devi on her tiptoes with both arms around a thin guava trunk, leaves falling around her shoulders, the single fruit still high above

scenes.narration: Nanu got there first, crying under the branch with both arms up. It was the only guava left, and too high for either of them.
scenes.caption: नानू पहले पहुँच गया और हाथ उठाकर रोने लगा। पेड़ पर बस वही एक अमरूद बचा था।
scenes.image_brief: Nanu, a three-year-old boy in striped shorts, standing barefoot under the guava branch with both arms raised and crying, Devi beside him looking up at the single fruit above

scenes.narration: Devi fetched the courtyard broom, turned it bristles-up, and tapped the stem with the long handle. "One guava, and two of us," she said, skirt held out wide.
scenes.caption: देवी झाड़ू लाई, उसे उलटा पकड़ा और लंबे डंडे से डंठल को ठकठकाया।
scenes.image_brief: Devi holding a long courtyard broom upside down with the bristles in the air, tapping the guava stem with the handle end, her yellow frock held out wide in her other hand like a bowl, Nanu watching

scenes.narration: The guava thumped into her skirt. Devi split it along the seam with her thumb and gave Nanu the bigger half. Count with me: one half, two halves. Her half tasted better than a whole one.
scenes.caption: अमरूद उसकी फ्रॉक में गिरा, देवी ने उसे दो हिस्सों में खोला और बड़ा हिस्सा नानू को दिया।
scenes.image_brief: Devi and Nanu sitting side by side on a courtyard step, each holding half a guava split along its seam, the half in Nanu hands slightly larger, warm morning light on the stone

scenes.narration: One guava, and two of us.
scenes.caption: एक अमरूद, और हम दो।
scenes.image_brief: Two guava halves resting on a courtyard step with two pairs of bare feet beside them, dappled light through the guava tree
